headline: Oil Prices Fall as U.S. Moves to Restart Iran Peace Talks
summary: Crude oil prices fell after U.S. Vice President JD Vance contacted the secretary of the Iranian Supreme National Security Council to restart peace talks.
why: Crude oil benchmarks like Brent and WTI are vital global commodities whose prices directly influence energy sector equities, inflation expectations, and geopolitical risk premiums.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Prospects of easing geopolitical tensions with Iran reduce supply disruption risks, driving down crude oil futures.

why_moved: The prospect of resumed peace talks and reduced geopolitical tension in the Middle East eases fears of immediate supply disruptions, prompting profit-taking and lower crude prices.
